key_insight: Execution-state capsules generalize reuse from KV-cache fragments to the entire graph-bound execution state, enabling fast checkpoint/restore for low-latency, small-batch on-device AI serving.
engineering_relevance: This is useful for interactive agents, speech models, and robot policies that frequently branch, interrupt, and resume under tight responsiveness budgets.
method: Capture the complete restorable state at a committed graph boundary
Store live state in contiguous static buffers with no block-table indirection
Restore/fork/roll back KV, recurrent, convolution, MTP, and metadata state together
evidence_signal: On RTX 5090, restore is byte-exact and greedy-decoded outputs are token-identical; GPU-resident snapshot/restore is sub-millisecond and TTFT speedup rises from 3.9x at 2k tokens to 27x at 16k tokens.
watch_item: The approach depends on a white-box runtime and backend-facing graph capture, so integration may be harder than standard KV-only serving stacks.
paper_title: Execution-State Capsules: Graph-Bound Execution-State Checkpoint and Restore for Low-Latency, Small-Batch, On-Device Physical-AI Serving
